h1: What are the rules for calling Dig Safe before excavating in Newton, MA?
title: Massachusetts Dig Safe Rules for Newton Excavation Projects
description: Learn when Massachusetts requires Dig Safe notification and how the notice period is counted before excavation.
short_answer: Massachusetts requires excavators to contact Dig Safe at least 72 business hours before covered excavation. Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays do not count toward that period. The law applies broadly to excavation on public and private property, including work associated with construction and utility installation.

facts.text: Massachusetts says excavators must contact Dig Safe at least 72 business hours before excavation and must not begin before the assigned start time.
Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 82, Section 40A requires covered excavators to provide advance notice and premark the proposed excavation location.

qa.q: Do weekends count toward the 72-hour notice period?
qa.a: No. The Massachusetts notice period is counted in business hours and excludes Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays.
